# ChadScanner

> ChadScanner is a free, Windows 10/11 x64 item scanner for Escape from Tarkov (EFT). Shift + click an item in the stash and a large floating card shows how many the player still needs for quests and hideout upgrades (found-in-raid aware, Kappa/Lightkeeper aware) and its flea market and best trader price. It works from screenshots and OCR only: no game memory reading, no injection, no game-file changes.

- Download: one zip, `chadscanner-win-x64.zip`, only from GitHub Releases. Extract (e.g. to `C:\`), run `chadscanner.exe`, set EFT to Borderless.
- Data: items, quests, hideout, prices, barters and crafts from tarkov.dev, refreshed every 10 minutes.
- Progress: local file (TarkovTracker backup format) or TarkovTracker.org sync via API token per game mode; built-in TarkovTracker window.
- PvP and PvE: switched automatically from EFT's log files.
- Hotkeys: Arrow Up hands one item in to the next open objective, Arrow Down undoes; scan button configurable (Shift + Left, Alt + Left, Middle, Mouse 4, Mouse 5).
- Updates itself from GitHub Releases (checked at start and every 6 hours).
- Not affiliated with Battlestate Games.
